comparison.objective: Replace a printer toner cartridge and close the printer door.
comparison.physical_skill: Extract and insert a keyed cartridge along rails while avoiding a sensitive roller.
comparison.success_condition: Old cartridge safely placed, new cartridge seated, door closed, arms clear; drops, excessive tilt, or roller contact fail.
comparison.reason: Large-part extraction and guided seating are meaningfully different from granular screening and bridge-clearing.
